record.relationship: Overlays SC 17 COVID regime. Distinct legal justification/order, not an extra non-overlapping period of frontier closure.

record.context: The interior order imposes a 12-hour election-day frontier closure. It is recorded as a distinct legal measure overlapping SC17 COVID policy; the government announced land and river COVID reopening separately on 28 February 2022. No additional non-overlapping duration is assigned.
record.uncertainty: The 06:00–18:00 legal schedule is verified. Expiry of this electoral order did not itself repeal other COVID measures and does not prove actual reopening. COVID overlap is policy-level context; March 2021 operations at individual posts were not independently established.
